score_observations: Composer-authorized excerpt reproduced in ECM+ retrospective printedp119 was visually inspected. SectionA is marked Aggressively, quarter note144.

Excerpt has rapid dynamic shifts from very soft to ff/fff/ffff, accents, trills, upper-register passages with8va, dense accidentals and a5:4figure. Some saxophone sonorities are written with stacked noteheads, requiring consultation of full performance instructions.
The piano part contains dense chords and rapid runs. Only the short opening excerpt was inspected; complete range and duration requirements are not inferred.
